itemListElement.name: Japanese Head Spa in Salem, WI

acceptedAnswer.text: A Japanese Head Spa is a cosmetic scalp-care and relaxation experience combining scalp analysis, customized products, cleansing, warm-water therapy and massage. The exact steps and massage time depend on the service you book.

mainEntity.name: What is a Japanese Head Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Matrix Signature Head Spa is the core 60-minute experience at $135. Choose Scalp Cleanse & Refresh for a 45-minute visit, or a longer Head Spa for more massage and scalp-care time.

mainEntity.name: Which Head Spa should I choose for my first visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Hair is left wet. Professional drying or styling must be booked separately, so arrange it in advance if you want that service.

mainEntity.name: Will my hair be dry when I leave?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your provider can discuss scalp care for your hair needs. Contact Matrix first if you have extensions, braids, very short or thinning hair, recent chemical services or scalp concerns so the suitable approach can be confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Can I book with short hair, thinning hair or extensions?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Matrix Head Spa services focus on cosmetic scalp care and relaxation. New hair loss, painful or inflamed areas and persistent scalp symptoms should be evaluated by an appropriate healthcare professional.

mainEntity.name: Does Head Spa treat hair loss or scalp disease?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose Matrix Head Spa + Hydrating Glow Facial for a 120-minute combination at $285. The booking menu also offers men’s Head Spa combinations with a mini facial or a custom facial.

mainEntity.name: Can I add a facial to my Head Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a schedule around your preferences, scalp comfort and the experience you enjoy. Your provider can discuss a suitable return visit; a fixed weekly schedule is not required.

Visit Matrix Massage & Bodywork at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. Our Salem studio serves Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Union Grove, Twin Lakes, Trevor, Bristol and nearby Antioch, Illinois. All appointments are at this Salem location. Book online or text 262-939-9325.
